source: Vestergaard & Osmer 2009, ApJ 699, 800 (arXiv:0904.3348v1) — 本地 PDF 抽取 (pdftotext)
definition: Ψ(M_BH,z) = comoving space density of black holes per unit BH mass (Ψ = dN/dM); 單位 Gpc^-3 M☉^-1 (Table 6/7/9)
beta_definition: 高質量端斜率 β, 由 Ψ ∝ M^β 擬合 (Vestergaard+08 方法); 即 d lnΨ/d lnM

footnote6_LBQS.note: PDF footnote 6 原文逐 bin 值; 質量 bin 下限選取以確保 (近乎) 完備
footnote6_LBQS.uncertainty_note: 論文: uncertainties ranging between 0.4 to 1.4; 冇逐 bin 個別 σ

quotes.summary: amplitudes and slopes (of about β ≈ −3.3 with uncertainties between 0.4 and 1.4) of the high mass end of the mass functions for different redshift bins and across quasar samples for redshifts below ∼3.5
quotes.flatter: for the well-defined and complete SDSS color-selected sample of quasar at redshifts between 3.6 and 5 we find a somewhat flatter slope of β = −1.75 ± 0.56
quotes.turnover_caveat: mass functions show turn-overs toward low masses due to incompleteness
